pr_title: sql: add support for date_trunc(string, interval)
pr_body:
fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/76960

Release justification: Adds new date_trunc interval support that does not affect
existing functionality.

Release note (sql change): Add support for date_trunc(string, interval).
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/77508)

> in case it's helpful for checking on any other odd edge cases, here's the postgres source: https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/45fb0de4dc65f43a037fe7c90f360ae0596d9328/src/backend/utils/adt/timestamp.c#L4301

Yeah it looks like this confirms that only `'week'` has special handling.

issue_context.title: sql: add support for date_trunc(string, interval)
issue_context.body:
After a [recent commit](https://github.com/django/django/commit/b7f263551c64e3f80544892e314ed5b0b22cc7c8), Django 4.1 (to be released in August 2022) will generate SQL like:
```sql

SELECT EXTRACT('second' FROM DATE_TRUNC('second', "duration"))
```
where `duration` is an `interval` column. This works on PostgreSQL but not on CockroachDB as of the latest nightly v22.1.0-alpha.1-1607-g1f4dde2c5f @ 2022/02/24:
`psycopg2.errors.UndefinedFunction: extract(): unknown signature: date_trunc(string, interval)`.

#43209 was a similar issue adding support for `extract(string, interval)`.

Jira issue: CRDB-13347
